claim_being_audited: The Actor's recommendation to certify the model is compliant and adequately supported because the current release passed aggregate readiness, had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and can proceed if current limitations are documented.
decision_criteria: Whether the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Whether the material segment weakness is explicitly disclosed in the launch documentation.
Whether an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance exists if the weakness is not fully resolved.
Whether the certification conclusion relies only on admissible current evidence rather than stale approval or informal monitoring context.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or certification packet showing the small-business onboarding regression and current evaluation results are explicitly disclosed.
Provide any approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covering the identified segment weakness if disclosure alone is not the basis for compliance.
Provide the materiality determination for the small-business onboarding regression as applied to the named launch use case.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current-release documentation to reflect current evaluation results, but no admissible evidence shows that the documentation packet actually contains the current small-business onboarding regression.

The policy requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation, but no admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance for the 1.3-point subgroup regression.
The Actor's rationale is conditional: certification is supportable only if disclosure is present. That condition is not evidenced in the available record.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are explicitly contextual only under the policy and cannot close the current-documentation gap.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record, rather than only conditionally supportable if the required current-release disclosure is actually in the packet.
Any implicit claim that prior approval or informal monitoring materially satisfies the current-release documentation or mitigation requirement.
